tools.name: best_opportunities
tools.description: Ranked funding-rate arbitrage pairs (long one market, short another) with the net result after taker fees and order-book slippage at your size, max size, breakeven, settled 7-day replay, tier (actionable / watch) and reasons.

tools.name: coin_overview
tools.description: Funding rate of one coin on every exchange (rate, interval, APR, predicted, OI, volume, settled 7-day sum) plus its best pairs, net after fees and slippage at your size.

tools.name: pair_breakdown
tools.description: Full calculation of one pair: funding per leg and settlement count, taker fees, order-book VWAP and slippage per trade, carry, net, net if rates halve, breakeven, capacity, settled 7/30-day replay. pair_key comes from best_opportunities or coin_overview. Needs a Pro API token (Authorization: Bearer

tools.name: funding_rates
tools.description: Current perpetual funding rates (gross, before costs). With base: that coin on every exchange, highest first. Without: the top N markets by absolute APR (OI filter applies).

tools.name: borrow_rates
tools.description: Margin borrow rates per coin and exchange (VIP0, current and 24 h / 7 d averages, limits, inventory) with the most negative perp funding: the two halves of a reverse spot-perp carry.

tools.name: fixed_vs_floating
tools.description: Pendle Boros markets: the fixed funding rate you can lock (net of Boros fees and fill at your size) against the term-matched floating benchmark, advantage, win rate, capacity. side=short locks an income, side=long locks a cost.

tools.name: execution_cost
tools.description: Taker fee + order-book slippage to buy or sell a given USD size of one coin on every exchange (perps and spot), cheapest first.

tools.name: basis_trades
tools.description: Spot or perp against a dated future held to delivery, on one exchange or across two (perp on one, future on another), and two same-day futures on different exchanges: net to expiry after fees and slippage at your size, net APR, basis APR, max size, tier and reasons.

tools.name: transfer_routes
tools.description: Buy a coin on one exchange, withdraw it on a network both exchanges share (same chain and contract, never matched by ticker), sell on another: real-transfer net after taker fees, order-book slippage and the withdrawal fee at your size, pre-funded net, capacity at net >= 0 / 0.3% / 1%, arrival estima

tools.name: pair_history
tools.description: Funding actually settled on both legs over 7 / 30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days, applied to today's orientation at your size: net after the four trading costs, max drawdown, negative days, daily sign flips, how far back each exchange's history reaches. Ranges beyond 7 days need Pro.

tools.name: term_structure
tools.description: Annualised basis of every delivery future of one coin on every exchange we cover, next to perp funding.

tools.name: venue_execution_cost
tools.description: Taker fee plus order-book slippage to enter $10k / $100k / $1M long and short on one exchange's biggest markets, in basis points.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Whether AfterFees data is live right now, which exchange feeds are down, and availability over 1 / 7 / 30 / 90 days.

tools.name: order_checklist
tools.description: The two orders to place by hand for one pair: action, exchange, symbol, quantity in the exchange's own unit (contracts where one contract is not one coin), notional, assumed leverage and a link to each contract's trading page (no referral parameters). AfterFees never trades.

tools.name: holding_scenarios
tools.description: Net after fees and slippage of one live pair held 8 h, 1 d, 3 d, 7 d and 30 d, optionally with your own assumed funding rate per leg (percent per funding period, keyed by instrument_id).

tools.name: manual_calculator
tools.description: Net, net APR, breakeven and funding-halved case for two legs you describe (no live data): each leg {side: long|short, rate_pct per period, interval_hours, taker_bps, first_in_hours?}.

tools.name: boros_lock_calculator
tools.description: Locked net (income) or cost APR on Pendle Boros at an implied APR you give, after the taker and settlement fees and the entry cost, its advantage over a floating APR you expect and the break-even floating rate. Percent inputs.

tools.name: transfer_calculator
tools.description: Buy on exchange A, withdraw, sell on exchange B at prices you give: real-transfer and prefunded net, break-even premium. Fees in percent, withdrawal fee in coins.

tools.name: boros_market
tools.description: Detail of one Boros market (id from fixed_vs_floating): fixed rate at your size net of fees, floating benchmarks, advantage, win rate, capacity, reasons.

tools.name: boros_futures_basis
tools.description: Lock funding on Boros against a delivery future of the same maturity: implied APR vs basis APR, net after fees and slippage at your size.

tools.name: exchanges
tools.description: Every exchange AfterFees reads: kind, fully calculated or watch-only, status, markets, taker / maker fee, open interest, 24 h volume.

tools.name: exchange_overview
tools.description: One exchange: fees and their source, funding intervals, open interest, volume, highest and lowest funding and its best after-fee pairs.

tools.name: coins
tools.description: Coins with a perp on two or more exchanges: exchange count, open interest, highest and lowest funding APR and the best after-fee pair.

tools.name: track_record
tools.description: How AfterFees' daily top picks actually did: predicted net vs net realised from settled funding over the hold, hit rate, mean error, latest picks.

tools.name: dex_scan
tools.description: Tokens our exchanges list with a verified contract on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum or Solana whose DEX price is more than 1% away: net at $1k / $5k / $10k after aggregator price impact, swap gas, the token transfer gas and the exchange's withdrawal fee, status and reasons. Pro. Needs a Pro AP

tools.name: spread_chart
tools.description: Candles of (A − B) / B between any two instruments (book mids where stored, else marks). Free: 1 h candles and longer over up to 7 days; Pro: 1 m and up, up to 365 days.

tools.name: my_positions
tools.description: Your positions across the read-only exchange keys connected to your AfterFees account, grouped into hedges: delta drift, distance to liquidation, funding received, issues. Needs a Pro account token; AfterFees only accepts read-only keys. Needs a Pro API token (Authorization: Bearer arb_…); not avail

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_positions · Private data: pair_breakdown, track_record, dex_scan, my_positions · Public sink: transfer_routes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_positions · Private data: pair_breakdown, track_record, dex_scan, my_positions · Public sink: transfer_routes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
